# timeseries-resample

> Resample irregular time series into fixed UTC buckets with seven aggregations and fill gaps by forward, backward, linear time-weighted or zero fill with limits. Package name `timeseries_resample`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objectives and scope
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): API and resampling logic
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to test
